Find Us

The Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training, established in 2011, works to expand access to quality education across Pakistan. Its mandate covers school, college, and professional training initiatives, along with inter-provincial coordination on education matters. The Ministry also manages Pakistan Study Centers, Pakistan Chairs abroad, and projects that strengthen skills development and human capital.
